mdcw_cw_add_tension.what: Changes Cold War Tension (0-100, start 45, monthly drift to 40 + 0.1 per inter-bloc sanction, max +8). Tension drives Market Confidence (100 - 0.7 x tension ...), Arms Demand (0.8 x tension ...), the political-climate tiers (Brink 80/Confrontation 60/Elevated 40/Detente 20/Calm) and the Imperia oil risk premium (+0.3 model $ per point above 50).
mdcw_cw_add_tension.guards: Clamped 0-100 by the effect. Optional has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized. Use the effect, never add_to_variable on global.mdcw_cw_tension (the generic tree's GEN_1970_change_tension does that and skips the tier/display/GUI update).
mdcw_cw_add_tension.used_in_coldwar_sov: 52 calls in 52 foci (sum +66 / -44); also events and decisions

cw_world_state_read.what: Read-only world state for available/bypass/ai_will_do/scaling: tension, Market Confidence, Arms Demand, tiers, bloc shares and scales, bloc member counts, oil price level and ratio, CPI.
code: check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_share_2 > 0.299 }   # Soviet bloc >= 30 % of world power (Global tier)
cw_world_state_read.guards: Read-only. Values exist only after mdcw_cw_initialize (1970 game).
cw_world_state_read.used_in_coldwar_sov: tension read in 2 foci (ple_gre, the_end_of_detente) + 1 decision + events; oil level in 1 focus (petrodollars); market/arms/shares: 0

mdcw_cw_change_alignment.what: Moves the country to another bloc (0 Non-Aligned, 1 West, 2 Soviet, 3 Beijing). Charges 15 PP per bloc point (max 150; half to NA) and sets a 730-day lock unless mdcw_cw_t_free = 1. Leaving a bloc: 180 days mdcw_cw_diplomatic_realignment, opinion malus from the old leader, event mdcw_cw.3; tension + bloc_value x 0.2 (x0.1 from NA, x0.05 to NA). ALL subjects of the country follow their overlord.
mdcw_cw_change_alignment.guards: Guard with mdcw_cw_can_join_<west|soviet|beijing|na> (ruling-party fit + lock). Team pattern for foci: mdcw_cw_t_free = 1 (EGY, SOV). MP: subjects (incl. human Warsaw Pact members under autonomy_warsaw) are moved too. For SOV leaving bloc 2 the effect gives SOV an opinion modifier towards itself and fires mdcw_cw.3 to SOV.
mdcw_cw_change_alignment.used_in_coldwar_sov: 4 foci (we_join_the_free_world, nts_into_the_west, chr_join_the_free_world, na_join_the_movement), all with mdcw_cw_t_free = 1

mdcw_cw_bloc_triggers.what: Scripted triggers (file common/scripted_triggers/mdcw_cold_war_triggers.txt, not staged; names from the generator index): mdcw_cw_can_join_west/_soviet/_beijing/_na, mdcw_cw_can_change_alignment, mdcw_cw_party_fits_west/_soviet/_beijing, mdcw_cw_party_core_*, mdcw_cw_fits_own_bloc, mdcw_cw_is_bloc_leader, mdcw_cw_is_active, mdcw_cw_same_bloc_as_prev, mdcw_cw_opposing_to_prev, mdcw_cw_has_link_with_prev, mdcw_cw_can_embargo_prev, mdcw_cw_is_opec_member, mdcw_cw_is_major_oil_exporter, mdcw_cw_is_oil_exporter.
mdcw_cw_bloc_triggers.guards: Bloc leaders and subjects always fit their bloc (never estranged).

mdcw_cw_assistance_capacity.what: Custom modifier (number). Adds programme capacity on top of the power-rank base (superpower 8) and the bloc-leader tier bonus (0-3). Read by mdcw_cw_recalculate_capacity via modifier@.
code: mdcw_cw_assistance_capacity = 1   # in an idea / dynamic modifier
hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes } }
mdcw_cw_assistance_capacity.guards: Call mdcw_cw_recalculate_country after a change (the national ideas do this in on_add), otherwise the Programmes tab stays stale until the monthly tick.

mdcw_cw_support_effectiveness.what: Custom modifier (%). Multiplies the popularity our Public Political Support campaigns (50 PP diplomatic action) give abroad (sponsor side).

mdcw_cw_ideological_defence.what: Custom modifier (%). Reduces the popularity foreign Public Political Support campaigns give inside our country (1 - value, clamped 0-1).
mdcw_cw_ideological_defence.guards: Not listed in the as-built doc but defined in mdcw_cold_war_modifiers.txt.

mdcw_cw_military_programme_cost.what: Custom modifier (%). Cost factor of our military assistance programmes (Military Training Mission, Arms Production Assistance).
mdcw_cw_military_programme_cost.guards: Clamped at 0 (cannot go negative). Recalc as for capacity.

mdcw_cw_assistance_limit.what: Custom modifier (%). Raises the per-effect caps of incoming programmes (receiver).
mdcw_cw_assistance_limit.guards: Only useful for countries that receive programmes (not the USSR).

mdcw_cw_assistance_effectiveness.guards: Receiver side; incoming effects also scale with Imperia development (Developing x1.25, Developed x0.6) and great-power competition (x1.1).

mdcw_cw_market_exposure.what: Custom modifier (%), negative colour. Multiplies the Cold War world-market effects (exposure = globalism_value/50, x (1 + this), clamp 2.5). A typical 'price' for opening foci.

mdcw_cw_programmes_and_pps.what: Player diplomatic actions on the target: Assistance Programme (25 PP; 8 types: Construction Assistance, Technical Mission, Industrial Equipment Program, Productivity Mission, Consumer Supply Credits, Military Training Mission, Arms Production Assistance, Administrative Assistance; sizes 1-3) and Public Political Support (50 PP). The receiver accepts or declines.
code: # not callable from a focus: start via the diplomacy screen. Foci change capacity/cost/effectiveness modifiers only.
mdcw_cw_programmes_and_pps.scope: sender scope with PREV = target (internal effects)
mdcw_cw_programmes_and_pps.guards: Never call mdcw_cw_start_program_N / mdcw_cw_start_pps from a focus (bypasses the receiver's consent and capacity checks).

mdcw_cw_bloc_leader_decisions.what: Player-only decisions (is_ai = no): mdcw_cw_dec_comecon (SOV leader, 75 PP, every 1095 d; 730 d: members efficiency growth +5 %, oil price resistance +10 %; SOV upkeep x1.5, oil export income -5 %), mdcw_cw_dec_detente (any bloc leader, 75 PP/365 d, tension -3, pairs within 90 d), mdcw_cw_dec_show_of_strength (any bloc leader, 50 PP/180 d, tension +3). Soviet Credits are for members only (not SOV).
code: set_variable = { mdcw_cw_refund_comecon = 25 }   # proposed CW-generator hook, see proposals
mdcw_cw_bloc_leader_decisions.guards: Generated file; do not patch by hand (the SOV generator currently ships a patched copy for the Comprehensive Programme refund).
mdcw_cw_bloc_leader_decisions.used_in_coldwar_sov: 1 focus (the_comprehensive_programme) via a hand-patched copy of the generated decision file

mdcw_cw_detente_initiative.what: Effect behind the Detente decision: pairs with another bloc leader's initiative of the last 90 days (both get mdcw_cw_detente_agreement 365 d, tension -5, news to humans) or opens a 90-day offer flag. An offer, so MP-safe.
code: limit = { is_ai = no has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized mdcw_cw_is_bloc_leader = yes }
custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SOV_detente_offer_tt   # "We open a Detente initiative: if another bloc leader takes 'Detente Initiative' within 90 days, both get Detente and tension falls by 5."
mdcw_cw_detente_initiative.guards: Guard: mdcw_cw_is_bloc_leader = yes and is_ai = no (the AI never takes CW decisions). Does not include the decision's own -3 tension.

mdcw_cw_ideas.what: CW timed ideas that can be reused as rewards/prices: mdcw_cw_show_of_strength (war support +5 %, army XP +5 %), mdcw_cw_detente_hawks (war support -5 %), mdcw_cw_detente_agreement, mdcw_cw_diplomatic_realignment (automatic on leaving a bloc). Member-only: mdcw_cw_soviet_advisers, mdcw_cw_imf_conditions, mdcw_cw_self_reliance, mdcw_cw_nam_summit, mdcw_cw_competing_offers.
mdcw_cw_ideas.guards: Ideas file not staged; names from decisions/loc.

mdcw_cw_national_ideas.what: Ten CW national ideas in Imperia's pools (150 PP, 1440-day lock flag_ni_mdcw_*, on_add recalculates CW). For the USSR in 1970: available = Broadcasting (AI takes it as bloc leader), Border Regime (communist; AI takes it in the Soviet bloc), Development Agency, Open Door, Import Substitution, Export-Led, Military Advisers; not available: Loyalty Boards (needs a West-fitting party), Armed Neutrality (Non-Aligned only), Strategic Petroleum Reserve if SOV is an oil exporter. Oil Price Indexation from the as-built doc no longer exists.
mdcw_cw_national_ideas.guards: AI weights live in the ideas themselves; a focus should discount, not grant (slot behaviour of add_ideas in a law category with 2 slots is unverified).

mdcw_cw_oil_system.what: OPEC price level global.mdcw_cw_oil_level (0.5-12) over the Imperia market; real ratio global.mdcw_cw_oil_ratio; CPI global.mdcw_cw_cpi. Player tools: OPEC ballots (mdcw_cw_dec_oil_price_agreement / _price_cut / _output_restraint; OPEC members, humans vote, AI abstains) and bilateral oil embargo / exemption diplomatic actions (MDCW_CW_OIL_EMBARGO_IMPOSE/LIFT, MDCW_CW_OIL_EXEMPTION_GRANT/REVOKE). Crisis tiers per country (mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_tier). The as-built 'Use the Oil Weapon' decision and 'Oil Price Indexation' were replaced by this.
code: # allowed in a focus: read globals, change own oil_export_multiplier_modifier, imp_oil_price_resistance, add_resource oil

# forbidden in a focus: mdcw_cw_start_opec_vote, mdcw_cw_start_oil_embargo, mdcw_cw_end_oil_embargo, set/multiply global.mdcw_cw_oil_level, imp_spike_oil_price, imp_oil_price_demand_raise/_lower, add_ideas = imp_oil_prices_ask_N
mdcw_cw_oil_system.guards: Player-only by design (Vorgabe Enes): no AI automatism may move the oil price.
mdcw_cw_oil_system.used_in_coldwar_sov: read once (petrodollars available); no forbidden calls (checked)

mdcw_cw_sanction_hooks.what: mdcw_cw_on_sanction_imposed / _lifted: called by the 8 Imperia sanction diplomatic actions (temp mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type 1-4); inter-bloc sanctions raise tension; bloc leaders' sanctions call bloc embargoes.

IMP_is_1970_scenario.what: Scenario trigger (has_start_date). Country scope; in scope-less on_startup use USA = { IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }.
IMP_is_1970_scenario.guards: Every 1970 mechanic is gated by tag + scenario.

imp_national_ideas_pools.what: Government-screen pools imp_national_ideas_1 'Our Society' / _2 'Our Economy' / _3 'Our Military' (law = yes, 2 slots each per playbook, 150 PP, removal 150, 1440-day lock flag_ni_<n>, Imperia ideas have ai_will_do factor = -10). Many fit the USSR 1970: Patriotic Education, Mandatory Youth Service, Censorship Bureaus, Mass Surveillance, Natality Campaigns (1); National Labour Mobilization, Urbanization Efforts, Worker Co-operatives, Resource Extraction Mandate, Innovation Ecosystem (2); Military Parades, Civil Militia, Army Reserve Mobilization, Civil Defence Drills, Maritime Industry Hub, Nationalized Steel, Special Forces Prioritization, Military Logistics Reform (3).
code: imp_national_ideas_2_cost_factor = -0.5   # engine '<idea category>_cost_factor' pattern (MD uses trade_laws_cost_factor, social_budget_cost_factor ...); first use for these categories -> verify in game and whitelist in validate_sov
imp_national_ideas_pools.guards: Discount yes (cost factor). Unlock no (would need edits in Imperia files). Grant via add_ideas only after testing the slot behaviour; on_add sets the lock flag.

imp_oil_market.what: Imperia oil market: global.imp_global_oil_price (model $, 75 = normal, clamp 15-200), equilibrium (30-135, set by exporters' asking-price ideas imp_oil_prices_ask_1..11 x export share x world dependency + CW premium), weekly 7.5 % adjustment; exporter ideas imp_major_oil_exporter (top 3) / imp_minor_oil_exporter (next 12) by net exports; wars/civil wars at exporters spike +22.5/+11.25. Player decisions d_imp_raise_oil_price / d_imp_lower_oil_price (is_ai = no, need interest group fossil_fuel_industry). Displays: global.imp_oil_price_display (dollars of the day).
imp_oil_market.guards: AI exporters never get asking-price ideas (decisions invisible), so their exports do not push the price. Adding oil resources only changes the exporter ranking.
imp_oil_market.used_in_coldwar_sov: indirect: 7 foci change oil_export_multiplier_modifier, 2 add oil resources (samotlor, the_tyumen_complex)

imp_oil_price_resistance.what: Custom modifier. Lowers imp_oil_dependency (base 0.4 + 0.3 x fossil power share + 0.3 x non-electric fuel use, min 0.2), which scales every high/low-price effect (investment duration, tax, social cost, productivity, consumer goods) and the CW oil crisis tiers. non_electric_fuel_consumption_modifier and nuclear/renewable power work on the same formula.
imp_oil_price_resistance.used_in_coldwar_sov: 0 (Soviet bloc network gives +10 % x scale automatically)

imp_trade_policy_oil_spike.what: imp_set_trade_policy: when a major/minor oil exporter changes its trade law, the oil price spikes +-0.10..0.40 x 75 (720-day cooldown). No caller in the staged files (trade laws call only ingame_update_setup).
code: # if this gets wired to trade-law on_add, AI-taken trade-law foci would move the oil price -> guard with is_ai = no
imp_trade_policy_oil_spike.used_in_coldwar_sov: 6 foci change the trade law (mixed_economy x4, md_closed_economy x2)

imp_sanctions.what: Four sanction kinds with arrays imp_<dip|fin|eco|mil>_sanc_on_us / _by_us (country scopes), strengths imp_*_sanction_strength (GDP share, offices, factories), effects imp_*_sanctions_p through dynamic modifiers imp_sanctions_<kind>_dynamic_modifier. Modifiers imp_sanction_resistance (receiver) and imp_sanction_effectiveness (sender). Imposing/lifting only through Imperia's diplomatic actions (which carry the CW hook). Player decisions: d_imp_check_sanctions_on/_by (reports), d_imp_consolidate_power (corruption +1, +300 PP when a sanction kind > 10 %).
code: any_of_scopes = { array = imp_eco_sanc_on_us tag = USA }   # read-only trigger
imp_sanctions.guards: Never write the arrays from a focus (bypasses strengths and the CW hook). Globalism also sets resistance (80 % at 0) and effectiveness (-80 % at 0).

imp_military_industrial_complex.what: IMP_military_industrial_complex_dynamic_modifier for countries with the interest group idea defense_industry: extra military-industry tax = 0.4 % x (Arms Demand - 25) (clamp -10 %..+30 %) + 0.5 % per country at war (max 10 %), total -10 %..+40 %. Recalculated monthly. AI countries get IMP_cold_war_ai_war_declaration_lock.
code: if = { limit = { has_idea = defense_industry } remove_ideas = defense_industry hidden_effect = { IMP_cold_war_update_military_industrial_complex_country = yes } }
imp_military_industrial_complex.guards: SOV has defense_industry from COLDWAR_SOV_initialize_1970, so the MIC is active. The as-built doc still says 2 % per point; the code uses 0.4 %.
imp_military_industrial_complex.used_in_coldwar_sov: indirect: 22 foci change defense_industry opinion, 4 use military_industry_tax_modifier, 3 international_market_income_modifier

imp_globalism.what: globalism_value 0-100 drifts (0.2 x (1 + globalism_rate_multiplier) per tick) towards modifier@globalism_equilibrium. Trade laws set -40 (closed) / +25 / +50 / +70 (mixed) / +50 / +35; blocs: West +5, Soviet -10, Beijing -15. Effects (imp_globalism_modifier): war support +20 %..-20 %, sanction resistance 80 %..0, sanction effectiveness -80 %..0, productivity growth -1..+1, ROI -2..+2 %, interest +2.5 below 50, investment duration +50 %..0. CW market exposure = globalism/50.
code: globalism_equilibrium = 5   # in a COLDWAR_SOV dynamic modifier (EGY pattern: COLDWAR_EGY_economy_globalism_equilibrium)
imp_globalism.guards: SOV starts at equilibrium about -50 (closed economy + Soviet bloc) = globalism 0; +5 changes nothing until the trade law opens. Changing globalism_value directly is a bypass - don't.

imp_development.what: Development tiers imp_eco_1/2/3_dynamic_modifier (Developed/Emerging/Developing) from overall_productivity (IMP_developed/emerging_productivity_level triggers, not staged); news events imp_economy.1/2 on promotion. Effects on interest, corruption cost, upgrade cost, pop growth, workforce; visibility of many Imperia national ideas; incoming CW programme effect x1.25 (Developing) / x0.6 (Developed). SOV 1970: productivity 385.4.
imp_development.guards: Read-only; never add/remove these modifiers from a focus.

imp_debt.what: MD debt via debt_change + modify_debt_effect; Imperia debt events fire by debt level (imp_eco_debt_high/_very_high/_low -> imp_economy.3-8) and bond events imp_economy.9-12 (Moody's, capital flight) after foreign bond sell-offs.
imp_debt.guards: Use the MD helper; Imperia reacts automatically.

imp_gdp_balance.what: Startup calibration only: IMP_1970_apply_starting_gdp_profile, IMP_1970_restore_state_productivity_profile, mdcw_imperia_apply_own_gdp_curves, employment fractions. Variables gdp_total, gdp_per_capita, overall_productivity are readable.
imp_gdp_balance.guards: Not for foci (would distort the calibration).

imp_infrastructure_costs.what: update_infrastructure_rate: weekly upkeep per building level - roads 0.005, air base 0.005, radar 0.007, anti-air 0.007, fuel silo 0.002, civilian shelter 0.008 (0.02 damaged), rocket site 0.001, stronghold network 0.05 - times (1 + infra_cost_multiplier_modifier). Every infrastructure/air base/AA/fuel focus therefore has a built-in running price.
imp_infrastructure_costs.guards: Note: the GDP scaling temp gdp_infra_cost_modifier is computed but never applied in the staged version.
imp_infrastructure_costs.used_in_coldwar_sov: indirect: ~19 foci build roads/air bases/AA/fuel silos

imp_nuclear.what: Strike consequences only: imp_tac_nuke_effects / imp_big_nuke_effects (state scope: contamination/devastation, casualties reduced by civilian_shelter 10 %/8 % per level, permanent building loss, news imp_nukes.1-4, global flags imp_first_tact_used / imp_first_nuke_used, global.total_nukes_explodes). No warhead-stockpile or test system in the staged files; MD law nuclear_status (nuclear_power_def/_off need reactor1 + sp_nuclear_warhead_program).
code: capital_scope = { add_building_construction = { type = civilian_shelter level = 2 instant_build = yes } }
imp_nuclear.guards: The staged SOV 1970 snapshot sets neither nuclear_status nor sp_nuclear_warhead_program (only the 2000 block does) - verify in game.

imp_refugees.what: War refugees flow automatically to attractive neighbours (score from GDP, GDP/capita, imp_refugee_pull_modifier); costs via imp_refugees_dynamic_modifier, integration via imp_refugee_integration_rate; idea imp_refugee_block_costs; events imp_refugee_event.1-4.
imp_refugees.guards: Mostly irrelevant for a closed USSR; CW Border Regime clamps immigration on adoption.

imp_corruption_events.what: corruption_event_1/2/3: random Imperia scandal events imp_corruption.1-12 (event_1 at corruption level 1-2 with 60 % nothing; event_2 at levels 1-5 with 40 % nothing; event_3 below level 8). MD helpers increase_corruption / decrease_corruption step the corruption_level_01..10 law.
imp_corruption_events.guards: Use as a hidden 'price' of foci that tolerate graft.
imp_corruption_events.used_in_coldwar_sov: 0 Imperia events; MD corruption helpers 23 calls in 21 foci

imp_minis.what: imp_set_investment_caps (outgoing/incoming investment slots by GDP + modifiers imp_investment_out_extra / imp_investment_in_extra), imp_calc_casualty_cost (imp_casualties_dynamic_modifier 'The Price of War', automatic in wars), diplomatic insult and volunteer actions.

imp_money_transfer.what: Player diplomatic actions Transfer Funds, Grant Subsidies (weekly), Purchase/Buyback Bonds; variables active_subsidies@TAG, given_bonds@TAG; helpers calculate_subsidies_in/_out, calculate_bond_size, calculate_new_bonds_held/_owed.
code: # not for foci; the SOV offers use COLDWAR_SOV_transfer_gdp_share (accepted by the partner) - keep it one-off
imp_money_transfer.guards: Do not write given_bonds/active_subsidies from a focus.

mdcw_infantry_research.what: mdcw_apply_1970_infantry_research (file common/scripted_effects/mdcw_1970_infantry_research_effects.txt, NOT staged) sets the 1940-1985 infantry/research profile with protection bonuses 25/75; called in the SOV history before the tree.
code: # foci: add_tech_bonus on CAT_small_arms etc. only; never set_technology infantry techs

mdcw_industry_1960s_70s_techs.what: Historical industry techs (from mdcw_industry_60s_70s_l_english.yml and mdcw_historical_industry_l_english.yml; tech files not staged): Carbon Fibre I/II (mdcw_pan_carbon_fibers_1961, mdcw_graphitic_fibers_1970: factory/dockyard output +3 %, efficiency cap +2.5 %), CAD / Solid Modelling (mdcw_computer_aided_drafting_1963, mdcw_solid_modelling_1975), Genetic Code / Gene Cloning / Sequencing (mdcw_genetic_code_1966, mdcw_recombinant_dna_1973, mdcw_dna_sequencing_1977), construction (mdcw_precast_construction_1960, mdcw_site_planning_1970, mdcw_resource_loaded_construction_1975, mdcw_preventive_industrial_maintenance_1975), machine tools (mdcw_numerical_control_1955, mdcw_industrial_robotics_1961, mdcw_factory_control_1970, mdcw_computer_controlled_machine_tools_1975, mdcw_flexible_manufacturing_1980), power (mdcw_regional_grid_1955, mdcw_grid_dispatch_1965, mdcw_grid_stability_1975, mdcw_supercritical_steam_1957, mdcw_large_hydro_turbines_1965, mdcw_combined_cycle_generation_1967).
code: add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_SOV_x bonus = 0.5 uses = 1 technology = mdcw_factory_control_1970 }
mdcw_industry_1960s_70s_techs.guards: Folders MDCW_EARLY_MATERIALS / _GENETICS / _POWER. Verify IDs and categories against the tech files.

add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_SOV_ni_window_economy days = 365 }   # new idea: imp_national_ideas_2_cost_factor = -0.5
custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SOV_ni_window_development_agency_tt   # "For a year, adopting §YInternational Development Agency§! (Government screen) costs half."
